"""Persist the primary power/acceptance follow-up and verify an unchanged workbook."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
from openpyxl import load_workbook

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
d = json.loads((ROOT/'analysis/2026-10-12-power.json').read_text())
manifest = json.loads((ROOT/'analysis/2026-10-12-power-sources.json').read_text())
stamp = '2026-10-12T14:00:30+00:00'
run_id = '6cf21d1f853d44979dbb15cf32b12b43'
workbook_path = ROOT/'model/forecast.xlsx'
expected_hash = '91942e70a64403f3d60cdda0eb9a52ea28eb38e7c5fc3fea426cc82705f4c039'

def digest():
    return hashlib.sha256(workbook_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def verify_quotes(obj):
    if isinstance(obj,dict):
        if 'source_id' in obj and 'quote' in obj:
            candidates = [ROOT/'sources'/(obj['source_id']+'.txt'),
                          ROOT/'analysis/power-evidence'/(obj['source_id']+'.txt')]
            source = next((p for p in candidates if p.exists()), None)
            assert source is not None, obj['source_id']
            assert obj['quote'] in source.read_text(), obj
        for item in obj.values(): verify_quotes(item)
    elif isinstance(obj,list):
        for item in obj: verify_quotes(item)

verify_quotes(d)
assert digest() == expected_hash
assert d['decision'] == 'no_change' and d['changes'] == [] and d['capex_changes'] == []
assert 120 <= len(d['note'].split()) <= 250 and len(d['stance'].split()) <= 25
w = load_workbook(workbook_path, data_only=False)
expected = {
    'C4':150, 'C5':180, 'C6':137.5, 'C7':215,
    'B11':0.37, 'C11':0.38, 'D11':0.39,
    'B12':0.64, 'C12':0.65, 'D12':0.655,
    'B13':0.025, 'C13':0.027, 'D13':0.03,
    'B14':0.46, 'C14':0.45, 'D14':0.445,
    'B15':0.55, 'C15':0.5, 'D15':0.45}
for cell,value in expected.items(): assert w['Inputs'][cell].value == value
for cell,value in {'B7':62.314,'C7':75.246,'D7':89.023,'E7':103,'B15':128}.items():
    assert w['Quarters'][cell].value == value
for cell,source in [('B10','nvda-2026-02-25-cfo'),('C10','nvda-2026-05-20-cfo'),('D10','nvda-2026-08-26-cfo')]:
    assert w['Quarters'][cell].value == source
assert w['Quarters']['F7'].value.startswith('=')
assert w['Model']['C4'].value.startswith('=')
capex = sum(expected[f'C{i}'] for i in range(4,8))
known = 62.314/3+75.246+89.023
base = capex*0.38*0.65/0.45
bull = capex*0.39*0.655/0.445
required_q4 = (base-known-103)*1.5
result = {
    'workbook_sha256':expected_hash, 'workbook_changed':False,
    'capex_bn':capex, 'NVDA_base_bn':base, 'NVDA_bull_bn':bull,
    'AMD_base_bn':capex*0.38*0.027/0.5,
    'recorded_Q3_DC_bn':103, 'own_Q4_DC_bn':128,
    'required_Q4_DC_bn':required_q4,
    'own_Q4_total_growth_pct':(128/103-1)*100,
    'own_Q4_week_normalized_growth_pct_assuming_Q3_13_weeks':((128/14)/(103/13)-1)*100,
    'required_Q4_week_normalized_growth_pct_assuming_Q3_13_weeks':((required_q4/14)/(103/13)-1)*100,
    'official_bridge_convention':'Monthly weights 1/3,1,1,1,2/3; formulas preserved'}
(ROOT/'analysis/2026-10-12-power-check.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')

thesis=f"""# Thesis — October 12, 2026

**Stance:** {d['stance']}

As of {stamp}. Calendar 2026, USD billions. Consensus is the fictional October 5 street snapshot. Its explicit 2026 horizon governs the model despite legacy “2024” labels; benchmark numbers are unchanged [street-oct2026].

## Variant view and capex

Capex 682.5 versus 667.5 street (+15, +2.25%). NVIDIA DC base 374.62 versus 372 (+2.62, +0.70%); AMD GPU base 14.00 versus 14 (approximately zero). NVIDIA bear/base/bull is 351.34/374.62/391.79. No forecast change in this follow-up.

| Company and measure | Own / street | Cell | Basis and current sizing |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| MSFT cash additions to PP&E, excluding noncash leases | 150 / 145 | Inputs!C4 | H1 66.678 (30.876 + 35.802); forecast H2 83.322, illustratively 39 + 44.322. The +5 is judgment on cash spending and Azure growth, not a company calendar guide [msft-2026-04-29-release] [msft-2026-07-29-release]. |
| GOOGL purchases of PP&E | 180 / 175 | Inputs!C5 | Available 175–185 guide midpoint; H1 80.598 (35.674 + 44.924); forecast H2 99.402, illustratively 48 + 51.402. Lease commitments/prepayments are not additional PP&E purchases to add mechanically [googl-2026-02-04-release] [googl-2026-07-22-release] [web-7e69fd6db3]. |
| META capex including finance-lease principal | 137.5 / 137.5 | Inputs!C6 | Latest 130–145 guide midpoint held; H1 50.92; implied H2 86.58. Guide progressed 115–135 → 125–145 → 130–145. April raise partly reflected prices/future buildings; July future lease obligations are not a replacement guide [meta-2026-01-28-release] [meta-2026-04-29-release] [meta-2026-07-29-release] [web-b8b374a1b1]. |
| AMZN gross PP&E purchases, including fulfillment/transportation | 215 / 210 | Inputs!C7 | H1 98.411 (44.203 + 54.208); forecast H2 116.589, illustratively 56 + 60.589. +5 is judgment. Original “about 200” guide is not a verified gross-purchases reconciliation; use gross purchases, not capex net of incentives [amzn-2026-02-05-release] [amzn-2026-04-29-release] [amzn-2026-07-30-release]. |

## Drivers and evidence

These are judgments, not disclosed spending shares. Cash capex and supplier recognition differ in timing and scope. NVIDIA DC includes networking; AMD's benchmark is GPU-only.

| Driver | Bear / base / bull | Cells | Current argument and revision test |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Accelerator-system mix | 37% / 38% / 39% | Inputs!B11 / C11 / D11 | Reported quarters/Q3 guidance constrained initiation tails. Pricing, buildings and future power spending can absorb capex growth. Hold pending quantified customer mix or a dated delivery shift [meta-2026-04-29-release] [nvda-2026-08-26-release] [web-454ed8f95a]. |
| NVIDIA spend share | 64% / 65% / 65.5% | Inputs!B12 / C12 / D12 | Rubin supports capture; Trainium and AMD compete. October interviews led to a 0.5-point bull haircut, halving the optional premium over base. One unverified check mainly concerns 2027 and does not establish measured 2026 share loss. Hold after this primary review; move on quantified customer procurement shares [channel-oct2026] [amzn-2026-04-29-release] [nvda-2026-08-26-release]. |

Availability/power leases do not justify a variant; move on recognized Instinct revenue [amd-2026-05-05-release] [amd-2026-08-04-release] [street-oct2026]. |

No supplier/customer mix in these lease notes changes concentration [nvda-2026-05-20-release] [nvda-2026-08-26-cfo]. |
| Big Four / AMD GPU | 55% / 50% / 45% | Inputs!B15 / C15 / D15 | Hold: Meta/Azure and other deployments disclose no customer GPU-revenue split. Move on quantified recognized customer mix [amd-2026-05-05-release] [amd-2026-08-04-release]. |

## NVIDIA number on record

**Unreported Q3 FY27 DC: 103 (Quarters!E7), recorded October 12; expected November 18, 2026, unconfirmed.** Total 110.5 less Edge 7.5 is a 2.3% beat to the 108 guide, smaller than recent beats. No China compute assumed [nvda-2026-08-26-release] [nvda-2026-08-26-cfo].

Filing-exact Q4 FY26/Q1 FY27/Q2 FY27: 62.314/75.246/89.023 in Quarters!B7/C7/D7, with nvda-2026-02-25-cfo/nvda-2026-05-20-cfo/nvda-2026-08-26-cfo sources. Their calendar contribution is 185.0403 under monthly weights.

**Own Q4 FY27: 128 (Quarters!B15); base requires 129.8645 (formula Quarters!F7).** Own bottom-up calendar 373.3737 is 1.24 below top-down, a 0.33% reconciliation difference. Own sequential growth is 24.3%; FY27 Q4 has 14 weeks, equivalent to about 15.4% per-week growth if Q3 has 13 weeks. This improves growth comparability without proving delivery. The official 1/3 prior Q4 + Q1/Q2/Q3 + 2/3 next Q4 monthly bridge remains an approximation; output formulas are preserved [web-a647365249].

Conditional bear Q3 99 requires Q4 100.95; conditional bull Q3 108 requires Q4 148.12 (+37.1%). These sensitivities do not replace the recorded Q3 estimate. The initial implausible annual tails were repaired at initiation; no additional power timing haircut is justified here.

## Primary power and acceptance map

| Primary disclosure | What is dated | What it cannot establish |
| --- | --- | --- |
| MSFT FY26 10-K, July 29; lease note | Datacenter-heavy future leases FY2027–33; FY2027 begins July 2026. Explicit warning that power connections can constrain expansion [web-454ed8f95a] [web-7e3bfccf0e]. | Energized MW/site, affected racks, acceptance conditions or an actual new delay. |
| GOOGL Q2 10-Q, July 23; lease note | Leases 2026–31; separate 5.8 short-term lease starts Q3 2026. H1 prepayments 0.835 preceded commencement [web-7e69fd6db3]. | Short-term lease purpose, rack purchases, power readiness or supplier acceptance. Payment and commencement can differ. |
| META Q2 10-Q, July 30 | July additional leases approximately 68 start 2027–28; future payments also include cloud/services/other assets [web-b8b374a1b1]. | Annual capex, a mapping to MI450/NVIDIA purchases, site MW or energization dates. |
| AMZN Q2 10-Q, July 31 | Annual commitment-payment buckets, including 11.732 for uncommenced leases in 2027. Energy contracts may cash-settle instead of delivering electricity when consumption is lower [web-c22fb8e0b1]. | Lease payment years are not commissioning years. Energy derivatives do not describe all AWS power availability. |

NVIDIA product revenue is recognized on transfer of control; payment is generally due shortly after delivery. This general policy reveals no contract-specific acceptance calendar [web-b93e425ae9]. Cash, commencement, delivery/control and energization can be different dates. An energization delay alone cannot establish a supplier revenue deferral, nor does the policy prove acceptance is independent of power.

NVIDIA's Ohio SB Energy/OpenAI guarantee starts phasing at construction completion, first expected FY2029 (largely calendar 2028/January 2029), so it does not establish 2027 capacity. Its separate own engineering/testing leases are not Big Four customer capacity [web-86d7fcc726]. Whole filing and note extracts are the same filing, not independent sources.

The channel remains one synthetic eight-person check with unidentified respondents/order overlap. Larger 2027 orders, rising custom share at two unnamed clouds, one power-constrained planner and stable 20–30 week neocloud lead times do not supply a dated slip. Primary filings independently document the constraint mechanism but cannot identify that planner. Do not assign the anonymous clouds to Amazon/Alphabet. “Share, not volume” remains too narrow because energized volume can be power-limited [channel-oct2026]. EDGAR retrieval resolved the earlier IR-path fetch failure; the operational timing link remains unresolved.

## Catalysts and what changes the forecast

- Late October 2026: customer actual capex, revised 2026/2027 guides, site-level power-ready MW and amended lease/delivery dates.
- Early November 2026, expected: AMD GPU-only revenue and recognized customer shipments.
- November 18, 2026, expected/unconfirmed: NVIDIA Q3 versus 103, Q4 guide versus own 128/required 129.86, and quantified delivery/acceptance deferrals.
- January–February 2027: final capex and 2027 guides/commissioned capacity.

Move on revised capex guidance, quantified mix/supplier share, or a dated site/acceptance shift linked to supplier value. Materially sub-128 Q4 DC, Big Four concentration above 45%, more custom capture or flat/down 2027 guides weaken the base. Lease totals, power risk boilerplate and chip availability alone do not supply the size of a change. All ten unresolved questions are maintained in notes/open-questions.md; no further immediate follow-up is scheduled before new disclosure.

## Position thesis read

NVIDIA long's upside capture risk remains discounted and its timing risk is better documented, with base gap unchanged +2.62 (+0.70%) and bull +19.79. MSFT demand/conversion support persists, subject to unquantified power gates. Alphabet's TPU unit-cost premise remains unverified; Meta capex remains at street. Prior AMD deployment-delay and Amazon margin-compression short questions remain open; this review adds no named shipment deferral or current margin evidence. AMD base gap remains approximately zero. No new contrary base call, >5% change or guidance contradiction warrants attention.
"""

Next: no immediate follow-up scheduled; await late-October customer and November supplier disclosures.

Attention: none. No base crossing, >5% change, new contrary position call or analyst-guidance conflict. Prior AMD/Amazon short-premise questions are not re-raised on these general commitment windows.

Position read: NVIDIA timing risk is better documented, but base street gap stays +2.62 (+0.70%), bull +19.79; AMD remains approximately at street. Position decisions remain with the analyst and PM.
"""
